items.source: use of PathMatcher and UrlPathHelper is deprecated for use at runtime in web modules in favor of parsed patterns with PathPatternParser.
items.translation: 使用 PathMatcher 和 UrlPathHelper 已弃用，在 Web 模块中运行时建议使用 PathPatternParser 解析的模式。

items.source: Extension of RestTestClient.Builder for tests against а standalone MockMvc setup.
items.translation: 针对独立 MockMvc 设置 的 RestTestClient.Builder 扩展。

items.source: Build a MockMvc instance by registering one or more @Controller instances and configuring Spring MVC infrastructure programmatically.
items.translation: 通过注册一个或多个 `@Controller` 实例并编程方式配置 Spring MVC 基础设施来构建一个 `MockMvc` 实例。

items.source: Configure factory to create a custom RequestMappingHandlerMapping.
items.translation: 配置工厂以创建自定义的RequestMappingHandlerMapping。

items.source: Sets up a single ViewResolver that always returns the provided view instance.
items.translation: 配置一个单例的ViewResolver，该解析器始终返回提供的视图实例。

items.source: Provide a custom Validator instead of the one created by default.
items.translation: 提供自定义的Validator，而不是使用默认创建的验证器。

items.source: Uses of StandaloneMockMvcBuilder in org.springframework.test.web.servlet.assertj
items.translation: `StandaloneMockMvcBuilder` 类在 `org.springframework.test.web.servlet.assertj` 包中的用法

items.source: Uses of StandaloneMockMvcBuilder in org.springframework.test.web.servlet.client
items.translation: `StandaloneMockMvcBuilder` 类在 `org.springframework.test.web.servlet.client` 包中的用法

items.source: Uses of StandaloneMockMvcBuilder in org.springframework.test.web.servlet.setup
items.translation: `StandaloneMockMvcBuilder` 类在 `org.springframework.test.web.servlet.setup` 包中的使用。

items.source: Support for testing Spring MVC applications via RestTestClient with MockMvc for server request handling.
items.translation: 支持通过 RestTestClient 测试 Spring MVC 应用程序，并使用 MockMvc 处理服务器请求。

items.source: Register one or more ControllerAdvice instances to be used in tests (specified Class will be turned into instance).
items.translation: 注册一个或多个将在测试中使用的ControllerAdvice实例（指定的Class将被转换为实例）。

items.source: A MockMvcBuilder that accepts @Controller registrations thus allowing full control over the instantiation and initialization of controllers and their dependencies similar to plain unit tests, and also making it possible to test one controller at a time.
items.translation: 接受 `@Controller` 注册的 `MockMvcBuilder`，从而允许像普通单元测试一样完全控制控制器及其依赖项的实例化和初始化，并且还可以逐个测试控制器。

items.source: Set the ApiVersionStrategy to use when mapping requests.
items.translation: 设置用于映射请求的ApiVersionStrategy。

items.source: Configure the parser to use for PathPatterns.
items.translation: 配置用于 PathPatterns 的解析器。

items.source: Set up view resolution with the given ViewResolvers.
items.translation: 使用给定的 ViewResolvers 配置视图解析器。

items.source: Contains built-in MockMvcBuilder implementations.
items.translation: 包含内置的MockMvcBuilder实现。

items.source: Create an instance by registering one or more @Controller instances and configuring Spring MVC infrastructure programmatically.
items.translation: 通过注册一个或多个@Controller实例并编程方式配置 Spring MVC 基础设施来创建实例。

items.source: AssertJ support for MockMvc.
items.translation: 支持 MockMvc 的 AssertJ。

items.source: Add interceptors mapped to all incoming requests.
items.translation: 为所有传入请求添加拦截器。

items.source: Add interceptors mapped to a set of path patterns.
items.translation: 添加映射到一组路径模式的拦截器。

items.source:
In a standalone setup there is no support for placeholder values embedded in
request mappings.
items.translation: 在独立部署中，不支持请求映射中嵌入的占位符值。

items.source: Specify the timeout value for async execution.
items.translation: 指定异步执行的超时值。

items.source: Set a ContentNegotiationManager.
items.translation: 设置一个 ContentNegotiationManager。

items.source: Provide a conversion service with custom formatters and converters.
items.translation: 提供带有自定义格式器和转换器的转换服务。

items.source: Provide custom resolvers for controller method arguments.
items.translation: 为控制器方法参数提供自定义解析器。

items.source: Provide custom handlers for controller method return values.
items.translation: 为控制器方法的返回值提供自定义处理器。

items.source: Provide a custom FlashMapManager instance.
items.translation: 提供自定义的 FlashMapManager 实例。

items.source: Set the HandlerExceptionResolver types to use as a list.
items.translation: 将要使用的 HandlerExceptionResolver 类型设置为列表。

items.source: Set the HandlerExceptionResolver types to use as an array.
items.translation: 将要使用的 HandlerExceptionResolver 类型设置为数组。

items.source: Provide a LocaleResolver instance.
items.translation: 提供一个 LocaleResolver 实例。

items.source:
Set the message converters to use in argument resolvers and in return value
handlers, which support reading and/or writing to the body of the request
and response.
items.translation: 在参数解析器和返回值处理器中设置要使用的消息转换器，以支持读取和/或写入请求和响应的主体。
